contracts.reasoning: CloudHost Inc. has raised monthly hosting fees by 31.8% ($350/mo increase), and the contract auto-renews unless notice is given by September 20. A draft renegotiation email has been prepared.
contracts.recommendedAction: Renegotiate or cancel before September 20, 2026 (15 days before the Oct 5 renewal) to avoid a 31.8% price increase ($1,100 to $1,450/mo).
contracts.emailSubject: Renewal Terms for CH-2024-118 — Requesting a Call
contracts.emailBody:
Hi CloudHost Inc. team,

Our production cloud hosting agreement (CH-2024-118) is coming up for renewal on 2026-10-05. We've noticed the price has moved from $1100/mo to $1450/mo. Before we renew, we'd like to discuss the terms. Could we get 15 minutes this week to talk through options?

[Internal note, not for the counterparty — unverified estimate, confirm before using in the actual ask: Standard cloud infrastructure hosting of similar tier typically runs closer to a 10-15% variance year-over-year; a 31.8% jump is significantly above current market adjustments.]

Thanks,
Founder
